name: Tesla Powerwall 3

why: Each unit provides 13.5 kWh of energy you can use, with separate expansion units for more storage.
check: One unit does not back up three phases. Confirm the gateway, configured output and compatibility with any existing solar or Powerwall.

name: Sigenergy SigenStor with BAT 10.0 modules
fit: A home wanting expandable storage, with solar and optional EV equipment managed together.
why: Storage can be built from modules. The current AU warranty gives 9 kWh available to use per BAT 10.0 module.
check: Confirm backup circuits and internet-related warranty conditions. An official recall names older 8/10/12 kW single-phase controllers; check the exact model and serial, rather than treating every SigenStor as affected.

sources.title: Current AU/NZ SigenStor warranty

sources.revision: Version 5.0, October 2024; includes existing-inverter verification requirements

image.alt: Sigenergy SigenStor BAT 10.0 battery module; controller and additional modules not shown.

warning: Recall: older SigenStor EC 8/10/12 kW single-phase controllers with quick-connect AC plugs, sold 4 March to 18 November 2025, may overheat and cause fire. Check the exact model and serial against the ACCC notice. Affected owners should keep the system online for firmware updates and arrange the free replacement with their retailer or Sigenergy service partner. Affected products receive an extra two-year warranty. The recall concerns controllers, not BAT 10.0 modules alone.

comparisons.pro: Can store spare energy from existing solar while keeping the solar inverter.
comparisons.con: Keeping solar working during a blackout needs verified inverter compatibility and the right connection.

comparisons.con: Backup equipment and wiring must be included; the quoted system limits which appliances run together.

comparisons.pro: 9 kWh available per battery block; more blocks can be added.
comparisons.con: A compatible system design still limits the size you can add.

comparisons.con: The chosen inverter limits which appliances run together; a bigger battery does not cover every circuit.

comparisons.con: Your inverter needs a minimum number of blocks and limits the maximum stack.

name: Sungrow SBH
fit: A larger or increasingly electric home whose bills or meter data show substantial later-day use.

comparisons.con: Confirm whether your existing solar inverter supports this exact battery.
More storage does not guarantee more blackout power; confirm which appliances can run together.
